subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Neither of my sisters / are interested to come / on a vacation with me.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **are interested to come**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence:
 
 
• **N****either **is an** adjective **as it is used with a noun.
 
• The Noun **'sisters'** is followed by **'are'** a helping verb but sisters is a **plural noun** so we **cannot use** are after it.
 
 
 
• For example:
 
 
• Neither of my brothers is helping me clear the table. (**correct**)
 
• Neither of my brothers **are** helping me clear the table. (**incorrect**)
 
 
 
• Similarly in this question are is** not acceptable** after the **plural noun**.
 
• Hence,** 'is'** should be placed after **'sisters'** to make the sentence grammatically correct.

​Therefore, the correct sentence is: **Neither of my sisters is__ interested to come on vacation with me.**
